517:
(a) This article is adopted to address and promote the interests of public safety, health and welfare of the City of Jesup and its citizens, to aid and assist in the recovery of stolen property, to aid and assist local law enforcement in fulfilling its public safety functions, and to facilitate peaceful, lawful, orderly and efficient pawn brokering, the purchase, sale and consignment of secondhand goods, the purchase and sale of junk or swap items, and the purchase and sale from members of the public of coins, gold, silver, and other used precious metals and gems within the City of Jesup.
(b) The city recognizes that pawnshops, secondhand dealers, junk dealers, junk collectors, coin dealers, gold buyers, silver buyers, and used precious metals and gems dealers are legitimate businesses authorized by or otherwise permitted under state law. However, the city finds that the services offered by such forms of business may provide an opportunity for individuals to potentially transfer stolen property to those businesses. The city also finds that consumer protection regulation is warranted in transactions involving these businesses. The city further finds that the various purchase, sale, swap, consignment or pawn transactions of pawnshops, secondhand dealers and junk, coin, gold, silver and used precious metals and gems dealers have expanded beyond the city's current ability to effectively or efficiently identify criminal activity related to them. The purpose of the city's regulation of pawnshops, secondhand dealers, junk dealers, junk collectors, coin dealers, gold buyers, silver buyers, and used precious metals and gems dealers is to prevent such forms of business from being used to facilitate the commission of crimes and also to ensure that they comply with basic consumer protection standards, thereby protecting the public health, safety and general welfare of citizens, pursuant to authority granted to the city by state law and the Constitution of the State of Georgia.
(Ord. of 6-19-2018(2))

Chief of police means the designated chief of police of the City of Jesup.
City council means the governing body of the City of Jesup, Georgia. principally, the city commissioners and the mayor.
Coin dealer means any person, firm, or corporation engaged in the business of buying or selling used or secondhand coins to and from the public for their value as collectors' items, for their value for gold, silver, or other precious metals content, or buying coins containing any gold, silver, or precious metals at a price above the face value of the coin.

Employee means any person who works in a pawnshop or a pawnbroker's, secondhand dealer's, junk dealer's, junk collector's, coin buyer's, gold buyer's, silver buyer's, or used precious metals and gems dealer's shop or establishment, whether on a part-time or full-time basis, regardless of whether remuneration is received or is not and whether classified as an employee or independent contractor for taxation purposes.
Gold buyer means any person, firm, or corporation engaged in the business of buying used or secondhand gold or objects made of gold or of gold alloy from the public.
Junk collector means any person not having a fixed place of business in the city who goes from house to house, or from place to place, gathering, collecting, buying, selling, or otherwise dealing in for the purpose of financial gain any old rags, sacks, bottles, cans, papers, implements, vehicles, household items, equipment, art work, furniture, tools, metal or other articles commonly known as junk or scrap or salvage property.

Month means that period of time from one date in a calendar month to the corresponding date in the following calendar month, but, if there is no such corresponding date, then the last day of such following month.

Person means an individual or any partnership, corporation, limited liability company, joint venture, trust, association, or any other legal entity however organized.

If the applicant is a corporation, the majority stockholder and each principal officer of the corporation must meet the qualifications as part of the applications process.
